# clickup_list (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `folder_id` (String) ClickUp folder_id path parameter required to create this list.
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `assignee` (String)
- `content` (String)
- `due_date` (Number)
- `due_date_time` (Boolean)
- `list_id` (Number) The List ID. To find the List ID, right-click the List in your Sidebar, select Copy link, and paste the link in your URL. The last string in the URL is your List ID.
- `markdown_content` (String) Use `markdown_content` instead of `content` to format your List description.
- `priority` (Number)
- `status` (String) **Status** refers to the List color rather than the task Statuses available in the List.
- `unset_status` (Boolean) By default, this is `false.` To remove the List color use `unset_status: true`.

### Read-Only

- `archived` (Boolean)
- `folder` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--folder))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `inbound_address` (String)
- `orderindex` (Number)
- `override_statuses` (Boolean)
- `permission_level` (String)
- `space` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--space))
- `start_date` (String)
- `start_date_time` (String)
- `statuses` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--statuses))
- `task_count` (String)
